name: PROXYBASE

device_limits.notes: The bundled CLI terms allow one device per public IP. Account-wide limits are undocumented.

ip_policy.quality_notes: The current official site explicitly lists residential and datacenter/server use. VPN and proxy connections are prohibited. Bundled CLI terms also prohibit using datacenter servers or emulators to fake activity.

warnings: Replacement integration awaiting authenticated enrollment, reconnect and credited-traffic tests.
On ARM hosts Money4Band currently falls back to its default platform for GHCR images. Native ARM deployment through Money4Band has not been verified.
app_details.compose_layer_reasoning: Current official site publishes both residential and datacenter rates; direct connections only.
app_details.install_limit_reasoning: One device per public IP, stated by the CLI bundled terms.
app_details.recommendation_reasoning: The replacement official client starts on amd64 and emulated arm64. Complete authenticated tests before promoting from candidates.
app_details.confidence_notes: Public registry architecture manifests and CLI help checked. ACCESS_TOKEN and DEVICE_NAME environment inputs are supported. Offline startup passed with a read-only root and writable /tmp; no persistent application files were observed. Provider traffic, payouts and identity retention have not been verified.
app_details.removal_history: Removed 2026-05-15 due to domain instability. Service may have shut down or migrated; zero accessible documentation found in 2025-2026 research. No verifiable signal that the peer-program is still paying out.

additional_details: Use the access token shown in your ProxyBase account dashboard, not the referral code or the old USER_ID. The provider publishes $0.50/GB for residential IPs, $0.10/GB for datacenter IPs and a $0.20 payout minimum. VPN/proxy connections are prohibited. This candidate replaces the archived client and still needs authenticated enrollment, reconnect and credited-traffic tests; no persistent state directory is documented.
